svg.title: pi-contour — see the shape of a change
svg.desc: A topographic heat field is progressively revealed across a module boundary. A staged patch is the source; contour lines carry review exposure outward. This is an illustrative identity animation, not a repository measurement. Reduced-motion viewers see the complete static composition.

g.text: See the shape of a change.
Evidence first. A question, not a score.
Quiet while you work. Clear at the checkpoint.
